title: Check for integer to enumeration casts that would produce a value with no corresponding enumerator.
summary: This is not necessarily undefined behavior, but can lead to nasty surprises, so projects may decide to use a coding standard that disallows these "unusual" conversions. It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.core.EnumCastOutOfRange. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for dereferences of fixed addresses.
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.core.FixedAddressDereference. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check for variadic functions that unconditionally use va_arg().
summary: It is possible to use such functions safely (as long as they always receive at least one variadic argument), but their careless use can lead to undefined behavior (trying to access a variadic argument when there isn't any), so it is better to avoid them. It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.core.UnconditionalVAArg. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for excessively padded structs.
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Taint analysis identifies potential security vulnerabilities where the attacker can inject malicious data to the program to execute an attack (privilege escalation, command injection, SQL injection etc.).
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.taint.GenericTaint. It applies to C, C++.

title: This checker warns for cases when the size parameter of the malloc , calloc, realloc, alloca or the size parameter of the array new C++ operator is tainted (potentially attacker controlled).
summary: If an attacker can inject a large value as the size parameter, memory exhaustion denial of service attack can be carried out. It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.taint.TaintedAlloc. It applies to C, C++.

title: This checker warns when the denominator in a division operation is a tainted (potentially attacker controlled) value.
summary: If the attacker can set the denominator to 0, a runtime error can be triggered. The checker warns when the denominator is a tainted value and the analyzer cannot prove that it is not 0. It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.taint.TaintedDiv. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.
